title.native: Šuplje priče: Zdej te je, a zdej te ni
title.english: Tall Tales: Now You Are, Now You're Gone

synopsis.native: Tajni detektiv zaradi psiholoških težav pri opravljanju svoje tajne naloge obišče zasebno psihiatrinjo in ji pove razlog svojega obiska. Ko ta misli, da je detektiv le še en običajen pacient, ki potrebuje „katarzični“ pogovor in razpravlja o svojih opojnih akcijskih detektivskih izkušnjah, spozna, da gre za veliko bolj zapleten primer, ki ga morda ne bo mogla vzeti v zakup.
synopsis.english: Due to psychological issues with performing his secret mission the undercover detective visits a private psychiatrist and tells her about the reason for his visit. When she thinks the detective is just another ordinary patient with a need for a "cathartic" conversation and discussing his heady action detective experience, she realizes he's a much more complicated case, a case she might not be able to take in her stride.
